facil.verification: At least 85% chord occupancy agrees with reference during every target note.

medio.method: Alternating verified melody and dyad responses. Bass only on selected chord responses from first chorus. No Etude note picks.
limitations: Melodic evidence unavailable after about 80 seconds; later accompaniment uses checked harmony only.
Chord and pitch estimates can still fail. Musical quality and difficulty need listening.
The original recording keeps its own piano and bass.

melb.verification: At least 90% of held frames supported by both pitch estimators, with vocal energy.

limitations: Only advanced remains an Etude adaptation without the new musical evidence gates.
Chord recognition and two vocal estimators can still be wrong; their agreement is not independent ground truth.
The vocal evidence becomes unavailable after about 80 seconds. The melody exercise leaves that region empty.
Original audio retains its existing piano and vocals. No source removal was performed.
Exercise difficulty remains provisional, requiring listening and a playing trial.
vocal_activity_method: Isolated vocal stem energy in 250 ms windows; signal presence, not proof of singing.
